name: player.style
description: Community and recreated skins for Video.js 10, installed as source from the shadcn registry at skins.videojs.org

scripts.build: vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter './skins/*' build && vp run build-registry#build && vp run site#build
scripts.typecheck: vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter './skins/*' --filter build-skin --filter build-registry --filter fit-check --filter site typecheck
scripts.test: vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter './skins/*' --filter build-skin --filter build-registry --filter site test && vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter fit-check test
